reviews.comment: Super nice guy! His grading is fair and each lecture is actually important to what we are learning. One of the first professors I have had at midlands that seems like they geniunely care and enjoy their job. 100% would take again!

reviews.comment: Professor Rozier only grades what he taught you so far, so if he doesn't talk about run-on sentences he won't take points off for them until he talks about them.

reviews.comment: Very chill professor. He wanted to see everyone pass his class and provided proper instruction and guidance. Engaging class discussions and presence. Would highly recommend this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The amount of homework Rozier assigns for an introduction English course is insane. He expects you to "base your schedule" around this class. The homework does not help your writing skills either, it is mainly discussion posts with a word count requirement. You receive feedback from other students in the same position as you, not the professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Rozier's class! He's very understanding and makes the class tolerable for his students. He is very clear and direct about the context of the class and what it will contain. There are pop quizzes frequently so be sure to read! Overall, a great professor! 10/10 recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: While his lectures are not mandatory they are very interesting and I recommend attending because it really helps for doing well on the exams. Pop quizzes once a week, but they are always at the beginning of class and online, so you can take them anywhere. Some interesting readings/films, though some are very long, so I recommend skim reading.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed ENGL 305 with Professor Rozier, it is very important that you read for the quizzes, but he grades easy and the content is actually interesting.

reviews.comment: Dr Rozier is awesome! Great lecturer and interesting content. Weekly journals though
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: This class has so much unnecessary work involved. It has a research paper involved and has homework due every MWF. I spent as much time on this class as I did for my genetics lab. The professor expected a lot but would take forever to grade things or send out link for peer reviews or meeting sign ups. Not an easy A!! :(
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Rozier would send out weekly announcements which helped me stay on track with his class. The assignments and group discussions are fairly easy as long as you do not wait until the last minute. The textbook was required, but I only used it as reference for formatting papers. As long as you follow the rubric, you should have an A in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Weekly readings, but it is an English class. The readings were not that long 10 pages at most. 5 question quizzes super easy but they were once a week so make sure you read. 2 exams with 5 quotes and 2 small essay questions about the reading. 2 close reading assignments about a text. Grades super easy and is very chill. Does not take attendance.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Rozier is by far one of the best teachers and professors I have ever had my entire academic career. He is always willing to listen and help. He treats all students equally and teaches concepts in a way that is easy to understand. He is funny and answers questions respectfully even if theyre dumb.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Rozier is easy to contact and responds quickly! He cares about his students. Assignments are fair and not too hard as long as you dont wait till the last minute. Discussions were surprisingly fun unlike other classes. The textbook is not required but can be used as a reference for the formatting of assignments. Highly recommend taking him!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I didn't realize how good of a professor Rozier was until I took more english classes the following semester lol. Definitely take him! He's one of the few instructors that will tell you exactly what he looks for in all your papers. This class is an easy A as long as you go to class and not leave your papers to the very last minute.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I LOVE HIM!!!!! I am not an english person but I needed one more literature class and he made coming to class really interesting and entertaining and he's funny in class. Also grades exams/essays easy!!! Take him if you can!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I really don't like English but Professor Rozier made this class bearable. He was always there to help when we needed it, especially during office hours. He is also super understanding if you have a conflict and will work with you (he gave me an extension on a paper). I'd recommend him for a lower-level English class, despite it being boring lol.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Rozier is honestly one of the best professors I've ever had. His lectures are interactive, easy to understand, and entertaining. He answers questions in a way that shows he cares and is nonjudgemental. He knows what he's talking about but also puts himself at the same level as the student. AMAZING prof you will NOT regret taking!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Overall Dr. Rozier is a good professor. Class is very entertaining and the HW usually consists of reading and watching a movie. Downsides are that he is very very liberal leaning and focuses more on gender politics rather than Texas as a whole.

reviews.comment: Dr. Rozier is such a caring person! I really recommend him as a professor. There were 4 papers but he gave extensions when needed. Don't really need the books except when he gives out quizzes. I would take another class with him.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I cannot say enough amazing things about him. I have a horrible reading disability and he worked with me to make sure I understood what was going on in the books. He also helped me write my final essay. If he sees you trying in the class he will for sure help you out.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Rozier is amazing! His lectures are interesting. I took this class over the summer so it was 1.5 hours of straight lecture, but it wasn't too bad since he's super easy to listen to. Overall, take him if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Rozier is great! He is truly passionate about English and cares about his students. Other than that, great prof!

reviews.comment: If you're not an english person, it's gonna be really hard.  I'm a bio major and this class was harder to me than Bio 1,2 Chem 1,2 Physics 1,2 Calc 1,2.  Be prepared to right a lot.  Hitting the word counts on the assigned materials was the hardest parts because then I would just use filler.  He's passionate, I just hated the class and fell asleep.

reviews.comment: There are 3 papers and 1 annotated bibliography. Class discussions over the readings are only graded for participation and you have an occasional quiz (5 or less) which are not hard at all as long as you skim.  He's super chill and willing to help your grade out if you show interest and go to his office hours. Pretty nice guy!

He's the best professor I've had at TAMU!! Dr. Rozier wants his students to succeed, & is always available to assist. He's also very nice & young so its easy to talk to him. There is a reading assignment every week, but it isn't hard & he'll discuss it in class. He prepares you on how to write an essay & gives great feedback over each one.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: He is an easy grader, but you have to show improvement. He grades harder as the course moves on. He gives extra credit and there is a participation grade so its best for you to show up.  He's pretty chill and cancels classes. He is very helpful in his office hours and gives good feedback on essays. Easy A if your a good writer, could make A if not.
